To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the supervised least squares solution can be extended to semi-supervised classification by implicitly constraining the parameters of the classifier; (ii) the resulting ICLS classifier has an intuitive and simple formulation and can be solved by a gradient descent method; (iii) ICLS is guaranteed to never lead to performance worse than supervised least squares; (iv) experimental results confirm the theoretical results in the multidimensional space.
